method: Isolated headless Edge. Real keyboard and pointer actions. A Level 1 checkpoint is earned through normal training. No QA parameter, injected save, simulation write, or audio-policy mock is used.
results: Default policy makes an automatic title request before a click
Default blocked audio exposes Enable title music
Default policy starts the title with at most one Enable click
Permitted-policy clean entry starts title without a click
Normal entry has no QA controls
Real training controls earn the Level 1 checkpoint
Training launch replaces the title with the campaign recording
Permitted-policy saved entry starts title without another click
Saved entry retains the earned checkpoint
Title playback does not advance the saved section
Saved entry launch and music controls fit 320 by 568
Stop leaves the saved entry quiet without changing its checkpoint
Saved-entry title restart reuses one audio context
Resume replaces the title without resetting Level 1
Manual pause remains quiet and hides title controls
Sound mute is saved through the real Options control
Saved mute prevents automatic title playback
Saved mute does not erase or advance the earned checkpoint
No title-entry page exception or resource failure occurred

limits: The permitted-policy flag is used only in an isolated test process. Default policy is reported separately. Native Web Audio state and recording sources are observed. These checks do not establish audible output, physical latency, all-browser autoplay permission, or human understanding. The user browser and its flags remain unchanged.
